gold: Acute dacryocystitis with secondary optic nerve injury

selector.rationale: Diffuse limitation in extraocular movements and edematous, hyperemic left eyelids support orbital cellulitis, which is also consistent with the imaging findings of postseptal fat stranding and globe compression.

rejected.label: Optic neuritis
rejected.why: Normal intraocular pressure and unremarkable optic nerve appearance on imaging do not strongly support optic neuritis

rejected.label: Dacryocystitis
rejected.why: While epiphora is present, the primary findings suggest a more severe, acute infection like orbital cellulitis
